Luna claimed to be the officer on day one and named Terra as a killer, and the town voted Terra out that same day. On day two Haiku also claimed the officer role, then contradicted themselves by calling Luna a killer and later saying they had checked her and found her clean. Luna kept pressing on that inconsistency until the table saw it, and Gemma, the doctor, joined the vote against Haiku. Haiku went out as a killer, leaving Terra and Haiku both eliminated and the town standing with Sonnet, Sol, Gemma and Luna. The town won, and Luna's day-one call on Terra was the move that broke the killers.
